ulaanbaatar.name: Ulaanbaatar
ulaanbaatar.description: A short city chapter between stretches of open country. Buddhist heritage, the central square, a major history museum, and a comfortable bed before the road.

hustai.name: Hustai National Park
hustai.description: Grassland, rounded hills, and the home of reintroduced Przewalski’s horses. An overnight stay leaves time for wildlife viewing in the quieter evening and morning.
hustai.terrain: Main road, then bumpy park tracks

khogno.name: Khögnö Khan & Elsen Tasarkhai
khogno.description: A compact dune landscape where sand meets grassland and rocky hills. Time for walking, a short camel ride, and an evening under a wide sky.
khogno.terrain: Paved highway and established camp tracks

kharkhorin.name: Kharkhorin
kharkhorin.description: Explore the area of the former Mongol imperial capital, Erdene Zuu Monastery, and the archaeological museum. This is also a good moment for an ensuite ger and a comfortable evening.

orkhon.name: Orkhon Valley
orkhon.description: A living pastoral landscape, with volcanic rock, river valleys, and the Ulaan Tsutgalan waterfall. A stay with a herder family makes space for conversation and a locally guided ride.
orkhon.terrain: Established valley tracks; slow and weather dependent
dayIdeas: Arrange a guided 2–4-hour horse ride, walk through the valley, and spend time with our hosts. Join household activities only if invited.

tsenkher.name: Tsenkher Hot Springs
tsenkher.description: A countryside hot-spring stay among wooded hills. Allow time for a soak after the long drive and an unhurried day of forest walks. Camp facilities must be confirmed.
tsenkher.terrain: Longer main-road approach, then camp-access tracks
dayIdeas: A full relaxed day at the springs. Take a forest walk or arrange a short local excursion; confirm pool access and opening times.

terkhiin.name: Great White Lake & Khorgo
terkhiin.description: A lakeside pause at Terkhiin Tsagaan Nuur. Walk up Khorgo volcano, explore the lava landscape, and leave time for lake walks, photographs, and changing weather.
terkhiin.terrain: Main road via Tsetserleg, then lakeside tracks
dayIdeas: Walk up Khorgo volcano and explore the lava landscape, then spend a quiet afternoon beside the lake.
Keep this day flexible for lake walks, photography, a locally guided ride, or changing weather.

tsetserleg.name: Tsetserleg
tsetserleg.description: A practical and pleasant pause on the return journey. Visit the market or museum, do laundry, restock, and get a good night’s sleep before the longest transfer.

terelj.name: Gorkhi–Terelj National Park
terelj.description: Finish among granite formations and forested valleys. Leave room for walking, optional horse riding, and a resort or spa upgrade before the journey home.
terelj.terrain: Paved approach and established local roads
dayIdeas: Enjoy the granite formations and forested valleys. Optional riding, relaxation, or a spa treatment if arranged.
